coordinate_system: Blender right-handed Z-up; supplied AABBs are each actual button_object mesh-local, not root-local or Unity-local.
interaction_root_convention: forward=-localZ;up=+localY;new cap press=+root-localZ; retained source G03 task key is click-only.
unity_import_note: Attach an independent Collider component to each actual button_object. BoxCollider hints describe the saved mesh-local AABB. Compare against imported Mesh.bounds after FBX axis or bake conversion; do not copy Blender axes blindly. No Collider component or hidden proxy mesh has been created.
measurement_basis: Actual full rollout mesh vertices before save; Blender local metres. Verify Unity imported Mesh.bounds after axis conversion.
